selection.scope: Existing selector: negative source-measured slow data paths, cap>=0.1pF delay>=1ns. Positive buf1/buf2 only. At most50; no clock/logic/state/macro changes. Not exhaustive closure.

proof.scope: Combinational duplicate output equations, retained cell inputs and state definitions; positive buffer contraction and Boolean pin permutations. Added state and opaque macro duplicates are forbidden. Unchanged opaque masters require identical input equations. Excludes timing, analog, SRAM interiors, initialization, CDC and extracted physical connectivity.

parts.meaning: Concatenate strictly in index order; verify every part and combined SHA256 before extracting. No original waveform samples removed.
